messages:
Raj Patel: FYI Lintree AI submitted a private-onboard request — custom NLU for product tagging in retail. They want PHI-aware redaction, 13B model (finetuned), and a safety eval before we flip traffic. Renewal window in ~90 days, so CS wants a clean runbook for risk mitigation.
Sara Nguyen: thanks Raj. can you paste their short ask and any sample data?
Raj Patel: pasted below (redacted): '5000 annotated product descriptions + 200k unlabeled user queries. target latency <120ms p50, on-prem VPC, must meet our safety gating for PHI and PII removal.'
Mike Chen: 13B on private infra — do we have a quantized artifact or do they want us to host the original fp16 weights? latency constraint points toward q4_0 or int8 path. Also need inference entrypoint / sample script.
Julia Park: for safety eval we should run: 1) automated PHI/PII injection tests, 2) adversarial prompt set (~1k), 3) human rating (n=500) for hallucinations and PII leakage. define pass thresholds: <=0.5% PII leakage, hallucination FNR <4%.
Raj Patel: they mentioned a tiny in-house PII filter but asked that we run a second-level audit. attached sample.csv (redacted) in the intake form.
OnboardBot: :white_check_mark: Intake received. Link to private onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboard/checklist/LI-1745987654
Eve (Legal): confirm data residency and if any supplier HSM/KMS requirements. also need to sign our standard private-deploy addendum before model access.
Sara Nguyen: propose timeline: week 0-1 preflight + artifact transfer; week 2 run automated safety & latency tests; week 3 human eval + canary (5% traffic) for 2 weeks; week 5 full rollout if metrics hold. This lines up with renewal if we start within 2 weeks.
Mike Chen: action for infra: request model tarball + sample inference call. sample command we need from them: 
```bash
python serve.py --model-path ./model.tar.gz --max-len 512 --batch 8
```
plus a small inference payload.
Julia Park: I'll assemble the eval harness. plan: automated tests (PII inject, adversarial), unit fuzzing, and a human rating task in Labelbox (500 examples). will track metrics in Eval dashboard and export delta alerts.
Raj Patel: Customer asks about cost impact on renewal. if we show 15-20% latency improvement via quantization, can push for Dedicated commitment.
Sara Nguyen: i'll capture enablement artifacts and a one-pager for kickoff. we'll record biweekly feedback capture sessions with their ML lead.
Eve (Legal): I'll circulate the addendum template by EOD.
Mike Chen: flagged infra tickets: #INF-4123 (artifact transfer), #INF-4124 (private cluster sizing).
Sara Nguyen: next steps/action items: Raj — confirm sample CSV + contact; Mike — prepare infra checklist; Julia — draft eval plan; Eve — legal addendum. target start date: 1745989800 (approx 48hrs). :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: noted. looping in Lintree contact: @marcos (cc). thanks everyone.
